svg.title: Startup Capital: A $45,000 Reference Plan
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-45000-reference-startup-capital; chart type: stacked_comparison; title: Startup Capital: A $45,000 Reference Plan; subtitle: Four buckets total $45,000 within the $18,000–$75,000 USD range.; chapter number: 4; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Numeric values encode the $45,000 central/reference startup allocation in USD. Details also provide complete $18,000 lean and $75,000 expanded allocations across the same four buckets. Startup capital is funding capacity, not revenue or an immediate operating expense. Choose equipment access and job commitments to fit available funding.; caption: Lean: $7,000 + $5,000 + $2,000 + $4,000 = $18,000. Reference: $18,000 + $12,000 + $6,000 + $9,000 = $45,000. Expanded: $30,000 + $20,000 + $10,000 + $15,000 = $75,000.; stages: label: Working-capital reserve; value: $18,000 reference allocation; 40.0%; numeric value: 18000.0; detail: Lean $7,000; reference $18,000; expanded $30,000. Fund receivable delays and job commitments. Model cash needs against the $4,000–$20,000 monthly operating expense planning range and separately fund variable direct job costs; a reserve does not guarantee runway through the 1–5 month time-to-first-deal window.; label: Mitigation equipment; value: $12,000 reference allocation; 26.7%; numeric value: 12000.0; detail: Lean $5,000; reference $12,000; expanded $20,000. Prioritize extraction, air movement, dehumidification, moisture meters, protective equipment, and calibrated measurement tools. Use rental access or suitable used equipment where needed and rent overflow capacity.; label: Vehicle and mobilization setup; value: $6,000 reference allocation; 13.3%; numeric value: 6000.0; detail: Lean $2,000; reference $6,000; expanded $10,000. Fund vehicle rental or lease deposits, secure storage, load restraint, and initial mobilization equipment. Lean deployment assumes access to a suitable existing or rented vehicle; ongoing costs remain operating expenses.; label: Business and technical setup; value: $9,000 reference allocation; 20.0%; numeric value: 9000.0; detail: Lean $4,000; reference $9,000; expanded $15,000. Fund licensing, training, insurance deposits, estimating setup, dispatch configuration, bookkeeping systems, and initial referral development. Limit launch scope to work supported by funded credentials and safeguards.

rect.title: label: Working-capital reserve; numeric value: 18000.0; value: $18,000 reference allocation; 40.0%; detail: Lean $7,000; reference $18,000; expanded $30,000. Fund receivable delays and job commitments. Model cash needs against the $4,000–$20,000 monthly operating expense planning range and separately fund variable direct job costs; a reserve does not guarantee runway through the 1–5 month time-to-first-deal window.

label: Mitigation equipment; numeric value: 12000.0; value: $12,000 reference allocation; 26.7%; detail: Lean $5,000; reference $12,000; expanded $20,000. Prioritize extraction, air movement, dehumidification, moisture meters, protective equipment, and calibrated measurement tools. Use rental access or suitable used equipment where needed and rent overflow capacity.

label: Vehicle and mobilization setup; numeric value: 6000.0; value: $6,000 reference allocation; 13.3%; detail: Lean $2,000; reference $6,000; expanded $10,000. Fund vehicle rental or lease deposits, secure storage, load restraint, and initial mobilization equipment. Lean deployment assumes access to a suitable existing or rented vehicle; ongoing costs remain operating expenses.

Fund licensing, training, insurance deposits, estimating setup, dispatch configuration, bookkeeping systems, and initial referral development. Limit launch scope to work supported by funded credentials and safeguards.
